description: Turn all or some pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees clockwise, or -90 for anticlockwise. Everything else in the file is kept. Saves as name-rotated.pdf unless output is set.

output.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to the original's name with -rotated, in the same folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

pages.description: Which pages to turn, such as "2, 4-6". Defaults to all pages.

name: pdf_rotate
title: Rotate PDF pages
